meta.name: synapse-layer
meta.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted persistent memory layer for Hermes Agent. Provides encrypted cross-session memory, Trust Quotient (TQ) scoring, and automatic recall across ALL channels (Telegram, WhatsApp, CLI, Discord).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加密存储并自动召回跨会话记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要你的智能体记住跨会话的上下文
copy.tagline_en: Encrypt and auto-recall cross-session memory for your agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need your agent to remember context across sessions

howto.what: 装上后，Hermes Agent 会在每次新对话开始时自动调用记忆召回，获取之前保存的用户偏好、项目信息等，并在所有渠道（如 Telegram、WhatsApp）共用同一份加密记忆。
howto.when: 每次开始新对话时，Agent 会自动调用 recall 工具加载记忆。

say.text: 回想我上次提到的项目A的进展。
say.note: Agent 会从记忆中检索相关内容。

say.text: 保存这条信息：用户偏好使用 pt-BR 回复。
say.note: Agent 会通过 save 工具持久化。

say.text: 搜索我之前关于API密钥的记录。
say.note: Agent 会调用 search 工具查找。

howto.what_en: After installation, Hermes Agent automatically calls recall at the start of every new conversation to retrieve past user preferences, project info, etc., and shares the same encrypted memory across all channels (Telegram, WhatsApp, etc.).
howto.when_en: At the start of every new conversation, the agent automatically invokes the recall tool to load memories.

say_en.text: Recall the progress of project A I mentioned last time.
Save this: user prefers pt-BR replies.
Search my past records about API keys.
